newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Jan balance of payment surplus 24.7 bln baht.
newsitem.headline: Thai Jan balance of payment surplus 24.7 bln baht.

text.p: Thailand recorded a balance of payments surplus of 24.7 billion baht in January following a deficit of 19.2 billion in December, central bank chief economist Kleothong Hetrakul said on Thursday.
She told a news conference that the balance of payments in January improved on the back of net capital inflows in that month which topped 10 billion baht.
The surplus helped increase the foreign reserves to $39.2 billion from $38.7 in December, she said.
The current account deficit narrowed in December to 19.1 billion baht from a revised 21.7 billion baht in November.
"The latest current account deficit figure reflects the growing stability (of the Thai economy) in the direction that we would like to see," she said.
